name: scobe
description: Build on a canvas of live browsers and editable frames that Codex can read and write to.

interface.shortDescription: Build on a canvas that Codex can read and write to.
interface.longDescription: Scobe is an infinite canvas of live browsers and editable frames. With this plugin, Codex can read the canvas, create frames with auto-layout, add text and shapes, style them, and snapshot any live web page into editable layers, all while you watch.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page hero on the Scobe canvas with auto-layout
Snapshot the sidebar from my open browser into editable layers in Scobe
Design a mobile settings screen in Scobe using my repo's colors and type
